nodes.label: next dev AGENTS.md Regeneration Mechanism
nodes.rationale: The agent-rules block inside AGENTS.md is automatically written and re-added by `next dev` (see node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js); deleting it from a diff only recreates the uncommitted change on the next run, so committing the generated block keeps the working tree clean instead of fighting the tool.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Notice
nodes.rationale: This customized Next.js version has breaking changes versus the model's training data (APIs, conventions, file structure), so coding agents are told to read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code and to heed deprecation notices -- preventing agents from generating code based on stale or incorrect pretrained assumptions.

nodes.label: Browser User-Gesture Audio Policy
nodes.rationale: Browsers require a user gesture before audio can play, so the app intentionally starts the ambient music only after the user clicks the volume button rather than autoplaying -- a deliberate design choice complying with browser autoplay-restriction policies.

nodes.label: Public Asset Path Convention (public/ folder)
nodes.rationale: Public assets must be referenced in components via absolute paths such as /images/peter.png, and files must not be imported from outside public/ at runtime -- this follows Next.js's convention of serving everything under public/ directly at the site root, keeping asset resolution predictable at runtime.

nodes.label: Skyline Width & No-Background Requirement
nodes.rationale: The skyline artwork should be kept wide (recommended 2400px or wider) and avoid baking in a background color, so it displays correctly along the bottom of the stage across viewport widths without visible seams or color mismatches.

nodes.label: Transparent PNG Requirement for Hanging Characters
nodes.norm_label: transparent png requirement for hanging characters
nodes.rationale: Hanging character art (peter.png, gwen.png) must be transparent PNGs so the web and swing animation remain visible around and beneath the characters.
